Title: Flowise: IDOR vulnerability exists at the GET /api/v1/organization/customer-default-source endpoint
Description: An Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability exists at the **GET /api/v1/organization/customer-default-source** endpoint. This flaw allows an authenticated attacker to bypass authorization checks and retrieve sensitive payment and profile information of other customers by manipulating the customerId parameter. The exposed data includes email addresses, account balances, currency types, and internal billing configurations.
